name: CW Metals Inc. Sheet Metal Fabrication
old_description: Our professional and experienced team takes care of most complex projects. We provide help with design, shop drawings, suggestions how to make your project better and more cost-effective.
about:
CW Metals Inc. operates from Long Island City, New York, where it specializes in ornamental metal stamping and sheet metal fabrication for the construction industry. The company’s professional team handles complex projects, offering design assistance, shop drawings, and suggestions to improve cost-effectiveness.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, custom and standard metal stamping, 2D laser cutting, assembly, and installation of components such as cornices, bay windows, wall panels, and roofing panels. A high‑tech 3D printing machine produces stamping molds directly from drawings or photos when no physical sample exists. Finished parts are shipped throughout the United States and Canada.

CW Metals serves construction, engineering, aerospace, and manufacturing sectors, with a notable focus on historic preservation and architectural metalwork. Project examples include the TEP Charter School in Manhattan, a hospitality and high‑end residential complex in New York City, the Tres Puentes housing complex in the Bronx, a copper skylight, and a sheet metal cornice — all recognized with six Lucy G. Moses Preservation Awards and two Preservation League of New York State awards.

The company emphasizes its innovative technology, claiming to be the fastest producer of ornamental sheet‑metal stampings in the United States, along with a commitment to quality, low cost, and the shortest lead times in the construction industry.

name: Cabinet Maker NYC
old_description: ,we can create custom designed cabinetry crafted exclusively to your specifications and aesthetic
about:
Cabinet Maker NYC operates a workshop in Brooklyn, New York, where founder Tamas Matyek leads a team of skilled artisans producing custom cabinetry and architectural millwork. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs bespoke kitchen cabinets, media walls, built-ins, furniture, and architectural millwork for luxury residential projects. Work is performed in their Brooklyn workshop using a blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern fabrication technology, adhering to AWI premium-grade standards.

Cabinet Maker NYC serves homeowners, architects, interior designers, and general contractors in the luxury residential market. Projects include custom kitchens, media rooms, closets, and one-of-a-kind installations for New York City apartments, lofts, and brownstones.

The firm emphasizes personalized service, collaboration with design professionals, and a minimum project value of $15,000 to ensure adequate resources for each commission. Founder Tamas Matyek has been featured in "At Home with Adrian Grenier" highlighting sustainable cabinetry practices.

name: Cable Components Inc
old_description: This website uses cookies to ensure you get the best user experience.
about:
Cable Components Inc operates from Sussex, Wisconsin, supplying electrical and solar power components through an online catalog. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed on its website.

The firm distributes a range of products including Heyco strain reliefs, bushings, grommets, and venting solutions; Staubli MC4 solar connectors, branch connectors, and crimping tooling; SolaDeck photovoltaic junction boxes and kits; Caplugs protective plugs, caps, and connector covers; Bumper Specialties rubber bumpers in hemispherical, cylindrical, and square profiles; Gripmaster insulated and all-metal strain reliefs; TechFlex braided sleeving and wrap; and Sealcon liquid-tight strain relief connectors. It offers value-added services such as cut-to-length tubing, same- or next-day shipping on stocked items, and no minimum line-order requirements.

Customers span the solar energy, electrical contracting, electronics assembly, and general industrial sectors. The catalog serves buyers seeking component-level parts for photovoltaic installations, wire management, and equipment protection.

The company emphasizes rapid fulfillment and flexible ordering, promoting same-day dispatch, low purchase-order minimums, and non-standard color options on select bushings and plugs as key differentiators.

name: Cable Man, Inc.
old_description: An OSP contractor that has built a reputation for high quality workmanship since 1972 and that prides itself in its knowledgeable staff, competitive pricing and ability to deliver quickly.
about:
Cable Man, Inc. was founded in 1972 and operates as an outside plant (OSP) construction contractor headquartered in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, with a corporate office in Biloxi, Mississippi, and additional locations in Metairie and Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and a satellite office in Alabama. The company began as a utility and telecommunications contractor serving the Gulf Coast region.

The firm provides full-service aerial and underground construction, maintenance and repair, engineering, splicing, testing, fiber optic installation, copper and coaxial cable work, cable pulling and blowing, directional boring, trenching, plowing, and utility conduit installation for gas, water, and sewer systems. It holds multi-year contracts with nationwide providers across several southeastern states.

Cable Man serves telecommunications carriers, electric utilities, broadband providers, and municipal water, sewer, and gas departments. Its customer base includes large national providers that rely on the company for infrastructure deployment and maintenance across the Gulf Coast.

The company emphasizes its knowledgeable staff, competitive pricing, and ability to deliver quickly, with a focus on quality production completed in a timely manner and a safety-first approach. It aims to build trusting relationships and a solid reputation for long-term business opportunities.

name: Cable TV
old_description: Click on your state to see provider information and find availability in your area
about:
CableTV.us operates from Milton, Delaware, as an online information portal that helps residential and business customers locate cable television, internet, and phone service providers in their area. The company does not state a founding year or ownership structure, and no founders are named in the available materials. It presents itself as a team of professionals focused on optimizing the user experience for finding and comparing local service options.

The platform aggregates provider data — including package details, channel counts, download speeds, and promotional pricing — from multiple carriers such as Spectrum, Xfinity, Viasat, and others. It does not manufacture, install, or resell any physical products or network services. Instead, it offers a search interface that uses GPS-based location tracking or address entry to return available providers, allowing users to compare plans and access carrier contact numbers for ordering.

The service targets consumers and small businesses seeking home or office connectivity, including TV bundles, broadband internet, and landline phone packages. Examples from the site show it surfaces offers with up to 550+ channels, download speeds up to 1 GIG, and bundle discounts across major national and regional providers. The company explicitly disclaims guaranteed accuracy and notes all logos and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

CableTV.us says its differentiation lies in GPS-based location identification that aims to return only serviceable results, eliminating the need for users to visit multiple provider websites or enter zip codes that may yield unserviceable addresses. It also emphasizes a consolidated comparison view for bundles, pricing, and features to save users time and money.

name: Caddock Electronics Inc
old_description: Caddock Electronics, Inc. manufactures precision resistors and resistor
about:
Caddock Electronics, Inc. is based in Roseburg, Oregon. The company manufactures precision resistors and resistor networks, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The firm produces over 250 standard models, including high-voltage resistors, current-sense resistors, chip resistors, high-frequency and RF resistors, load resistors, pulse resistors, and non-inductive power resistors. It also offers custom resistor and resistor-network solutions. Caddock employs proprietary resistance-film and process technologies to meet demanding performance requirements.

Caddock’s products are referenced for military and space applications, as indicated by dedicated sections on its website for those sectors. The company also notes compliance with REACH environmental regulations.

The company emphasizes its unique resistance-film and process technologies as the foundation for solving performance-critical challenges. Custom design capabilities and a broad catalog of high-stability, high-voltage parts further distinguish its offering.

Calico Cow Fabric & Gift Shop operates in Roswell, New Mexico The business has been serving the local quilting and sewing community since at least 2007, as indicated by its website copyright. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

name: California LightWorks
old_description: LED horticultural/grow lighting fixtures, manufactured domestically
about:
California LightWorks was founded in 2008 in Canoga Park, California. The company designs and manufactures LED horticultural lighting fixtures domestically.

The company produces the MegaDrive® system—a centralized power LED platform that eliminates overhead wiring and in-canopy drivers. The lineup includes the Linear series for greenhouses (MDL 400, MDL 600), the Vertical series for multi-tier indoor grows (MDV 400, 600, 800), the UnderCanopy system for lower-canopy lighting, and 3 kW and 10 kW power units that support up to 80 fixtures. Additional product families are the programmable SolarSystem® and plug-and-play SolarXtreme® series. All fixtures are built in the USA with in-house design, engineering, and support.

California LightWorks serves commercial greenhouse operators, indoor vertical farms, cannabis cultivators, and home growers. The MegaDrive Linear is tailored for greenhouse applications with minimal shading, the Vertical series fits multi-level rack systems, and the UnderCanopy system targets lower-canopy production. The company also markets directly to home cultivators through its Pro-Grade line.

The company emphasizes its Made-in-USA manufacturing, complete in-house control over design and engineering, and a five-year warranty. Its centralized power architecture reduces installation costs, heat load, and canopy electronics, while two-channel spectrum control allows stage-specific tuning. Fixtures carry UL 8750, CSA, and CE certifications; power units meet ANSI/CAN/UL 8800:2019.

name: California Rotational Plastics
old_description: CRP believes that our excellence in manufacturing combined with our superior customer service will make us your choice supplier when rotational molding is required.
about:
California Rotational Plastics, based in Oxnard, California, was established in 1994 as a veteran-owned and operated business producing custom rotationally molded products. The company began with a focus on rotational molding and has since expanded its capabilities.

The company specializes in rotational molding using materials such as LLDPE, HDPE, polypropylene, cross-linked polyethylene, plastisol, and TPU. Its capabilities include mold design and tooling (cast aluminum, fabricated steel and stainless steel, CNC-machined molds), secondary cooling and trimming fixtures, in-house mold maintenance, leak and pressure testing, partial to full product assembly, in-mold and post-mold graphics, mold-in inserts, UL capabilities, order fulfillment, and a formal quality control program for each product.

CRP serves the marine, medical, construction, irrigation, and aftermarket automotive industries, delivering custom parts for applications ranging from fluid handling to structural components.

The company emphasizes its excellence in manufacturing combined with superior customer service, backed by over 35 years of industry experience and a hands-on quality inspection process.

name: California Solar & Electric Inc.
about:
California Solar & Electric is based in Valencia, California. The company highlights 15 years of industry experience, with owner Chris the business.

The firm designs and installs residential and commercial photovoltaic systems, including rooftop, ground-mounted, and battery backup installations using products such as Tesla Powerwall and Enphase microinverters. An in-house team of certified solar professionals handles each project from custom design through permitting, installation, and system activation. The company also offers financing options including cash purchase, loans, leases, and power purchase agreements.

Customers range from homeowners seeking to reduce electricity bills to businesses such as offices and manufacturing facilities looking for scalable energy solutions. All projects are located within California.

California Solar & Electric emphasizes its status as a certified installer for brands including REC Solar, Unirac, Qcells, Enphase, Franklin, and Tesla. The company backs every installation with 25-year warranties covering equipment, workmanship, and performance, and promotes a five-step process from free consultation to system monitoring.
